<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex71032026-09-2903-47-26" status="unreviewed">
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re
               de ni ma yin te de lta na byug da'i rnaM dag shin du ston pa'i med med par thal ba dang | 'dir zhen pa
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="N004"/>dang | bya la bar rab du sphye basa shes pa'i gzhung dang yang 'gal la | rang bzhin rnaM dag de zhen pas stong pa tsam la 'jog
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="N005"/>na g nas nyan rang gi nyon mongs pa nyams pa lasogs pa 'di 'gal yang zhen pa'i ngo bes stong pas de yang rang bzhin rnam dag du thal bas na 1 ma thal lo ||</seg></TEI>
